The unit blindness is not by design, and it is the same 'two facts published without the fact that binds them' shape the estate keeps meeting.

items.root_cause: audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 builds its product list from files the engine may legitimately refuse (an expired browser-store ad) and then classifies a gap by looking the name up in the engine's candidates file. A name the engine never ingested is absent from that file for a reason that has nothing to do with rules, but Classify has no verdict for 'not ingested' and falls through to RULE-INVISIBLE, the paging verdict. So every Fareway ad rollover day (the store's own Sun-Sat cycle leaves a one-day gap) can manufacture actionable rule pages out of an expired ad, and a developer following the alert would widen a rule that already matches. This is the fail-open-reads-as-empty class from the other side: the audit reads its own input gap as the engine's blindness.
